title: Maximalist
content: Apply maximalist aesthetic with more-is-more philosophy. Mix multiple patterns boldly. Layer colors, textures, and decorative elements. Clash prints intentionally. Include abundant ornamentation. Use full color spectrum. No empty space - fill everything. Combine different cultural influences. Eclectic collected aesthetic. Bold, overwhelming, expressive atmosphere.

variants.simple: Create overwhelming maximalist design with clashing patterns, bold colors, and abundant decoration.
variants.detailed: Apply maximalist aesthetic with more-is-more philosophy. Mix multiple patterns boldly. Layer colors, textures, and decorative elements. Clash prints intentionally. Include abundant ornamentation. Use full color spectrum. No empty space - fill everything. Combine different cultural influences. Eclectic collected aesthetic. Bold, overwhelming, expressive atmosphere.
variants.advanced: Apply maximalist aesthetic with more-is-more philosophy - the antithesis of minimalism. Pattern mixing: fearlessly combine multiple patterns - florals + stripes + geometrics + animal prints. Layer 3-5 patterns with varying scales. Color abundance: use many colors simultaneously, can include clashes, jewel tones alongside pastels alongside neons. No fear of bold combinations. Surface coverage: fill all available space with pattern, texture, or decoration - avoid large empty areas. Texture layering: combine velvet, metallics, embroidery, fringe, sequins - multiple textures simultaneously. Cultural fusion: mix influences from different traditions - Moroccan tiles + chinoiserie + Victorian + tribal. Collections displayed: abundance of objects, grouped items, gallery walls, curated excess. Typography: decorative, can layer multiple fonts, embellished, sometimes overlapping. Borders within borders: frames containing frames, nested decorative elements. Color blocking with pattern: each color block can have its own pattern. Gold/metallic: abundant metallic accents connecting disparate elements. Photography: styled shots with many objects, layered backgrounds. Interior influence: "grandmillennial" style, eclectic collecting. Balance in chaos: despite excess, create visual flow through repeated colors or motifs. Interactive: reveals showing even more layers beneath. Implementation: careful z-index layering, SVG patterns, blend modes for interaction. Accessibility: CRITICAL - overwhelming visuals can be disorienting, ensure text areas have sufficient calm backgrounds, provide simplified alternative for important content.
